mechanism: Efavirenz is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that may reduce berberine concentrations, while berberine may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased efavirenz levels and potential toxicity.
action: Monitor efavirenz efficacy and toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring for efavirenz; assess berberine effectiveness; healthcare provider should evaluate the benefit-risk ratio of concurrent use.
